dialogues.speaker: Yarugin
dialogues.text: I have to pull myself together, and keep myself from slacking off for even just a second. The people of Sretomorozsk are counting on me!

dialogues.speaker: Yarugin
dialogues.text: I'm getting ready for the daily check on Kresnik's Torch. This, my friend, is a task that concerns the fate of each and every one of us here in Sretomorozsk.

dialogues.speaker: Yarugin
dialogues.text: Generally, every household here depends on the torch for their heating. And more importantly, the torch must continue working for our transport to keep running, and for the sake of our livelihoods.

dialogues.speaker: Yarugin
dialogues.text: So you'd think they'd hire more than one torch technician to keep things running around here... *Sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Yarugin
dialogues.text: So no matter what, I have to pull myself together, and keep myself from slacking off for even just a second. The people of Sretomorozsk are counting on me!

dialogues.speaker: Yarugin
dialogues.text: Goodbye. For the people of Sretomorozsk!
